pick.headline: Father Lawrence Jenco freed in Lebanon
pick.fbis: The Daily Report of July 28, 1986, (South Asia volume) noted in its regional review that Damascus radio reported Father Lawrence Jenco thanking President al-Asad and Syrian forces for his release, and Syria pledging to keep seeking the freedom of other hostages in Lebanon.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 144, 28 July 1986
evidence.snippet: …. Regarding Syrian movements, the clan- destine Radio Free Lebanon reported that Syrian intelligence officers arrived in Sidon and Al-Nabatiyah to monitor Palestin- ian movements. U.S. Hostage Released — Father Lawrence Jenco expressed his thanks and gratitude to Syrian President al-Asad and Syrian forces in Lebanon for their efforts in pursuing his release from Lebanon, Damascus radio reported.
